crossing_decision.functional_argument: The page-4 annotation gives about 400 V at the V18/T3 hot line. Joining it directly to the 41 V rail through documented R42=6.8 ohm would imply about (400-41)/6.8 = 52.8 A at the annotated peak, before any other branch, implausible for this source circuit. This excludes the joined alternative as the working model; it is not a waveform measurement or proof of a printed dot.
